request.description: Registers a client of the firm as a borrower: the person is matched or created by mobile, the business created for MSMEs, and the profile is owned by the firm. Refused when another firm holds referral protection (`LEAD_PROTECTED`) or the borrower already has a profile of their own or another firm's (`BORROWER_ALREADY_REGISTERED`). When the borrower later signs in with that mobile they see the same profile and applications. Partner context.
